configuration.universe: Point-in-time CSI300; same eligible intersection as locked V3.1 scores; as-of weekly membership and trade rules. No look-ahead or post-outcome survivor filter.

target.exit: five trading sessions after entry, close
target.formula: (adjusted stock return - BETA_120 * H00300 return)/max(VOL_20,0.01); weekly winsorize at mean +/- 3 sample SD, z-score. Training requires valid exit_date <= signal_date and earlier signal.

moe.expert_processing: weekly winsorize 3 population SD, z-score, zero fill, equal average within group then z-score
moe.normalization: using expanding mature training states only, population SD, clamp +/-3
moe.loss: -mean(IC)/(population_std(IC)+0.05)+0.15*mean(adjacent-week L1 weight difference)+0.05*mean(squared L2 distance to uniform)
moe.ensemble: mean routing weights across five eval-mode models

traditional.ridge: Weekly; clip oriented effective coefficients at zero only after state interaction. Deterministic linear solve.
traditional.features: 6 oriented centered percentile ranks (missing neutral); 5 standardized/clipped states and 30 interactions; state scaling of last fit; equal total sample weight to each mature week.
traditional.calendar: Anchor every fourth eligible weekly forecast to 2017-01-06; do not restart at new year. Ridge weekly. MoE quarterly on its own existing 12-week cadence.

portfolio.lookahead: strictly earlier weekly signal at execution open
portfolio.EMA_definition: Z-score each component by week using population SD; mix 50/50, then EMA 0.3 by code, new entrant starts at its raw score. Re-standardize and clip +/-3. Preserve prior EMA vector and last 52 mature calibration ICs.
portfolio.anchor: FloatMV, 20-session median with min 10 valid amount/(turn/100); keep original handling of missing weights
portfolio.execution_policy: identical open fills, sells before buys, lot/cash/price limits, suspensions and valuation as versioned engine; solver beta bands divided by eta

continuity.method: Replay anchored development state or restore a verified equivalent engine checkpoint, including cash, marks, locked shares, entitlements and unsettled payments. Match each terminal NAV and holdings before first 2026 trade. Continue H00300/FloatMV/EW from 2025-12-31 and preserve their own schedules and benchmark holdings. Historical initial 1m is not a 2026 cash deposit.
continuity.boundary: If combined official calendar produces an additional eligible 2025 year-end signal after the last published 2025 score, append causally before the first 2026 execution; preserve label maturity and phase. No insertion of future information or reset of EMA/model counters.

controls.once_only: Four accounts only, one signed-off performance release. Data/ledger validation may be repaired before release with an evidence log; no strategy reselection, tuning or performance-driven retries.
controls.data_audit: Reconcile corporate actions and price references; record-date entitlements, cash paid, stock bonuses, suspended days, mergers/exchanges/delist settlement and signed order/NAV reconciliations. Escalate unexplained exposed events, never synthesize terms.
controls.metrics: Net return vs each benchmark, annualized daily active IR (sqrt(252)), absolute and relative max drawdown including anchor; weekly equivalent turnover=sum gross_traded/opening_equity*5/N. Compare primary minus baseline within each fee.
controls.forward: Use latest completed weekly signal available as of request (target 2026-11-20 subject to official trading calendar). Isolate post-11-13 data; do not consume it until holdout accounting/results sealed. Extend frozen accounts causally to the signal week; show planned next execution, prior actual holdings, target weights and indicative orders, separate from historical fills.
controls.disclosure: Prior V1 forward-data work occurred; no 2026 returns inspected for this final registration. Development selection is not out-of-sample evidence.
